claims.text: Dicyclomine: start 20 mg four times a day;
claims.quote: The recommended initial dose is 20 mg four times a day.

claims.text: after one week it may be raised to 40 mg four times a day unless side effects limit it.
claims.quote: After one week treatment with the initial dose, the dose may be increased to 40 mg four times a day unless side effects limit dosage escalation.
claims.locator: 2.1 Oral Dosage and Administration in Adults

claims.quote: Dicyclomine hydrochloride is contraindicated in infants less than 6 months of age

claims.text: unstable cardiovascular status in acute hemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive GI disease and severe ulcerative colitis.
claims.quote: • unstable cardiovascular status in acute hemorrhage • myasthenia gravis [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.4 )] • glaucoma [see Adverse Reactions ( 6.3 ) and Drug Interactions ( 7.1 )] • obstructive uropathy [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.8 )] • obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.5 )] • severe ulcerative colitis [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.7 )]

claims.text: In hot environments heat prostration (fever, heat stroke from decreased sweating) can occur; if symptoms occur, stop the drug.
claims.quote: In the presence of high environmental temperature heat prostration can occur with drug use (fever and heat stroke due to decreased sweating). It should also be used cautiously in patients with fever. If symptoms occur, the drug should be discontinued and supportive measures instituted.
